roleTitle: Restoration and land stewardship project lead
summary: Project role that plans, permits, delivers and monitors ecological restoration and land stewardship projects: reading site history and reference conditions, adapting treatments to site response, designing monitoring, working with landowners and partners, and managing contracts, budgets and authorizations.
evidenceNotice: Reshaping claims are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S). No task has a v2 multi-rater assessment yet, so every task shows 'assessment pending'. Change indicators count active signals only (ADR-0028); all linked signals are at watch, so no change indicator moves. v1 values appear only as prior-evidence pointers.
